# Codex app-server 0.170.0 schema capture

Generated from codex-cli 0.170.0 on macOS on 2026-11-19 with `codex app-server generate-json-schema --out <temporary>` and `scripts/generate-codex-schema-contract.mjs`. The manifest records the 52 consumed schemas. Compared to [0.167.2](../0.167.2/README.md), 14 consumed documents differ; `ServerRequest.json` is byte-identical. No change to the minimum supported contract or approval policy. No native model session was used to capture these schemas.

The separate [participant configuration measurement](participant-config.md) uses the installed parser and no-turn app-server threads.
